name: 乾
situation_en: Heaven in motion — you are opening the game, driving it forward on your own strength.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Small

boundary_en: Does not predict how far the opening move can go; does not answer whether to move fast or slow, advance or retreat.

name: 坤
situation_en: Earth that carries — you are in the supporting role, receiving momentum and holding things steady.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long riding the momentum can last; does not answer whom to follow, or whether to let go or take over.

name: 屯
situation_en: The hardest part is the beginning — the idea exists but the road isn't open yet, like sprouts pushing through soil.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the hard part will pass; does not answer whether to hold on or turn back.

name: 蒙
situation_en: Darkness before dawn — facing what you don't yet understand; someone must light the lamp, or you pay tuition to learn.

edges_en.target_name_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled

boundary_en: Does not predict when understanding will dawn; does not answer whom to ask, or whether to study on or let go.

name: 需
situation_en: Clouds thick but no rain — the moment hasn't come; all you can do is wait, like waiting for rain.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Small

boundary_en: Does not predict how long the wait will be; does not answer whether to wait idly or do something else meanwhile.

name: 讼
situation_en: Two sides, each convinced they're right — you're in a dispute that can't be talked out privately.
boundary_en: Does not predict who wins and who loses; does not answer whether to fight to the end or yield a step.

name: 师
situation_en: Leading troops into a hard fight — you're not alone; discipline and direction rest on you.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the battle will run; does not answer whether to attack or defend, reward or punish.

name: 比
situation_en: People drawing close — you are the one others lean on; a network is forming around you.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long people will stay gathered; does not answer whom to draw close to or keep at a distance.

name: 小畜
name_en: The Taming Power of the Small
situation_en: Small savings, small obstacles — you've gathered something, but not enough; clouds gather, rain hasn't fallen.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Great

boundary_en: Does not predict when enough will be saved up; does not answer whether to keep saving or start spending.

name: 履
situation_en: Treading on thin ice — every step must land sure; slow, but steady.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the ice will thicken; does not answer whether to hurry across or go around.

name: 泰
situation_en: Heaven and earth in harmony — channels open, resistance low, like early spring when everything grows.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Great

boundary_en: Does not predict how long fair winds will last; does not answer whether to expand or pull back.

name: 否
situation_en: Heaven and earth apart — nothing gets through; it's like being muted, everyone talking past each other.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the blockage will open; does not answer whether to keep knocking or find another road.

name: 同人
situation_en: Among fellow travelers — you're with people heading the same way, pulling together.
boundary_en: Does not predict how far fellow travelers can go together; does not answer whom to ally with or keep at arm's length.

name: 大有
situation_en: Hands full — a time of abundance; resources and options are plenty, enough to distract.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Great

boundary_en: Does not predict how long abundance will last; does not answer whether to hold what there is or invest again.

name: 谦
situation_en: Low profile, wide road — humility opens doors here; stepping back creates space.
boundary_en: Does not predict when keeping a low profile will pay off; does not answer how deep to hide or how much to show.

name: 豫
situation_en: Easy times — relaxed and pleasant; enjoyment now, but vigilance tends to slip.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the easy days will last; does not answer whether to enjoy the moment or prepare for rain.

name: 随
situation_en: Following — the wheel isn't in your hands; choosing whom to follow matters more than speed.
boundary_en: Does not predict how far the one followed can go; does not answer whether to keep following or go solo.

name: 蛊
name_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
situation_en: The house needs repair — long-accumulated problems; nothing formed overnight, each must be dug out and fixed.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Great

boundary_en: Does not predict how long repairs will take; does not answer which problem to fix first, or whether to overhaul or patch.

name: 临
situation_en: Right at the front — you're close to the action; things are visible, tangible, within reach.
boundary_en: Does not predict what comes after drawing near; does not answer whether to handle things personally or let go.

name: 观
situation_en: Watching from above — in the observer's seat; see the whole picture before stepping in.
boundary_en: Does not predict what conclusion observation will yield; does not answer when to step in or how long to keep watching.

name: 噬嗑
situation_en: A bone stuck in the throat — an obstacle lodged across the path; it must be bitten through to move on.
boundary_en: Does not predict how hard the bone is to bite through; does not answer whether to bite through it or go around.

name: 贲
situation_en: Appearances matter — a time for polish and presentation; the surface must hold before anything else.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Great

boundary_en: Does not predict how long appearances can hold; does not answer whether substance or surface matters more.

name: 剥
situation_en: Paint peeling off the wall — things being stripped away layer by layer; watch what remains.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the peeling will reach bottom; does not answer whether to reinforce or abandon.

name: 复
situation_en: The turn — at the pivot from decline to renewal; the old is spent, the new just sprouts.
boundary_en: Does not predict how fast the recovery will come; does not answer whether to double down or wait and see.

name: 无妄
situation_en: Don't stir trouble — a time when restraint keeps you safe; hold your ground, add nothing extra.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long staying put keeps things safe; does not answer whether to hold the ground or probe ahead.

name: 大畜
name_en: The Taming Power of the Great
situation_en: The granary is full — a phase of deep accumulation; plenty stored, waiting for the moment to act.

edges_en.target_name_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
The Taming Power of the Small

boundary_en: Does not predict when the moment will arrive; does not answer whether to keep accumulating or strike.

name: 颐
situation_en: Nourishment — everything runs on what feeds it; what you feed, and what feeds you, shapes what grows.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the nourishment will last; does not answer what to feed, or what to cut off from feeding.

name: 大过
situation_en: The beam is bending — an excessive, extraordinary situation; ordinary moves won't do.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the extraordinary will last; does not answer whether to hold up the beam or replace it.

name: 坎
situation_en: Danger upon danger — pit after pit; the only way is through, one at a time.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the danger will end; does not answer whether to push through or wait for the waters to recede.

name: 离
situation_en: Fire needs fuel to burn — brightness here depends on attachment; clarity exists, but it clings to something.
boundary_en: Does not predict how far the light will reach; does not answer whom to lean on, or whether to stand alone.

name: 咸
situation_en: A felt response — mutual signals not yet spoken aloud, but both sides have received them.
boundary_en: Does not predict where the mutual pull will lead; does not answer whether to speak it aloud or wait a little longer.

name: 恒
situation_en: The long steady stream — winning by endurance here, not by bursts; it's about who doesn't break.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long endurance can hold; does not answer whether to add more or simply maintain.

name: 遁
situation_en: Time to step back — retreat is the wiser move now; not surrender, but keeping the mountain green.
boundary_en: Does not predict when retreat can turn back; does not answer how far to withdraw or what to take along.

name: 大壮
situation_en: Too strong — power in excess; great force snaps easily, holding back travels further.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the peak will turn; does not answer whether to rein in or strike while hot.

name: 晋
situation_en: Moving up — in an ascending channel, seen and lifted; the steps are underfoot, one at a time.
boundary_en: Does not predict how high the ascent can go; does not answer whether to climb fast or step steady.

name: 明夷
situation_en: Light obscured — brightness that can't show itself; keep it hidden and move quietly.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the darkness will last; does not answer whether to stay hidden or risk showing light.

name: 家人
situation_en: Household matters — the inside must be set right first; order within, and the outside follows.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Small

boundary_en: Does not predict when household matters will settle; does not answer whether to be strict or lenient.

name: 睽
situation_en: Seeing cross-eyed — mutual estrangement; neither side pleases the other, words don't land.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the estrangement will close; does not answer whether to seek common ground or part ways.

name: 蹇
situation_en: Water ahead, mountains behind — stuck between advance and retreat; both hard, caught in the middle.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the deadlock will break; does not answer whether to push forward or turn back.

name: 解
situation_en: The knot loosens — tension easing; what's been taut is slackening, room to maneuver appears.
boundary_en: Does not predict how far the easing can go; does not answer whether to press the advantage or rest a while.

name: 损
situation_en: Time to cut back — in a situation demanding reduction; give up a part to keep the whole.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Great

boundary_en: Does not predict when the cutting will bottom out; does not answer what to cut or how deep.

name: 益
situation_en: Someone adds fuel — gaining from outside help; the wind is fair, things are growing.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the gain will last; does not answer whether to expand on the momentum or steady it first.

name: 夬
situation_en: Showdown time — at a point where the break can't wait; delay breeds chaos.
boundary_en: Does not predict what the decision will bring; does not answer whether to cut fast or cut slow.

name: 姤
situation_en: Chance encounter — an unplanned meeting; uninvited, it happened; what follows is unwritten.
boundary_en: Does not predict what the encounter will bring; does not answer whether to grow close or keep distance.

name: 萃
situation_en: Gathering — people, things, matters converging; the place is warming up.
boundary_en: Does not predict where the gathering will head; does not answer whether to pull together or disperse.

name: 升
situation_en: Steadily rising — step by step upward; the channel climbs, keep it steady.

edges_en.target_name_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled

boundary_en: Does not predict which level the rise will reach; does not answer whether to speed up or gather strength.

name: 困
situation_en: Water trapped beneath the marsh — the resource exists but cannot flow. Not empty, but stuck.
boundary_en: Does not predict when release will come; does not answer whether to leave or stay, attack or defend.

name: 井
situation_en: A well — in the position of nourishing others; the water is there, but only for those who draw; the well feeds people, people must tend the well.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the well will run dry; does not answer whether to draw more or use sparingly.

name: 革
situation_en: The old order is spent — change is unavoidable; the old ways no longer turn, new rules are on the way.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the change will land; does not answer whether to swap fast or reform gradually.

name: 鼎
situation_en: A new cauldron set up — the old cleared away, the new frame stands; now it waits to be filled.

edges_en.target_name_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled

boundary_en: Does not predict when the new cauldron will stand firm; does not answer what to add, or whether to keep the fire blazing or let it simmer.

name: 震
situation_en: A thunderclap — sudden shock; the ground moves, everyone must find footing first.
boundary_en: Does not predict how many waves the shock will send; does not answer whether to duck or face it.

name: 艮
situation_en: Stop here — at the point where stillness beats motion; halt, see clearly, then decide.

edges_en.target_name_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled

boundary_en: Does not predict how long the halt will last; does not answer whether to stay stopped or turn around.

name: 渐
situation_en: Wild geese flying south, one stop at a time — progress by order; no rushing, each stage in turn.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the journey will arrive; does not answer whether to speed up or keep the order.

name: 归妹
situation_en: A mismatched union — joined without proper standing; together, but each knows the score.
boundary_en: Does not predict how far this union can go; does not answer whether to make do or part.

name: 丰
situation_en: At the peak of fullness — abundance overflowing; but fullness is where the turn begins.
boundary_en: Does not predict which way the peak will turn; does not answer whether to act at fullness or guard it.

name: 旅
situation_en: On the road — a sojourner on others' ground; not your territory, tread with care for hosts' moods.
boundary_en: Does not predict when home will be reached; does not answer whether to settle or keep moving.

name: 巽
situation_en: Wind finds every crack — working by infiltration, not force; follow the seams inward.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Small
Work on What Has Been Spoiled

boundary_en: Does not predict when the seeping will take effect; does not answer how deep to go or how fast to pull back.

name: 兑
situation_en: Laughter and talk — in a field of easy exchange; good mood, easy words, easy agreements.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the good mood will last; does not answer whether to talk deep or stop at the surface.

name: 涣
situation_en: Scattered sand — dispersion; hearts drift, things drift, nothing holds together.
boundary_en: Does not predict when the scattering will end; does not answer whether to gather in or let go.

name: 节
situation_en: Measure — in the seat of restraint; spend where due, save where due; proportion is everything.
boundary_en: Does not predict what restraint will bring in return; does not answer whether to tighten or loosen.

name: 中孚
situation_en: Sincerity — standing on trust; once trust is established, the way opens on its own.

edges_en.target_name_en: The Taming Power of the Small

boundary_en: Does not predict when sincerity will be repaid; does not answer whom to trust or whom to guard against.

name: 小过
situation_en: Small things may slightly exceed, great things must hold back — a time for small moves only.
boundary_en: Does not predict what follows the small excess; does not answer how small counts as small, or how big counts as a breach.

name: 既济
situation_en: Done — the work complete, the river crossed; but completion is when vigilance slips easiest.
boundary_en: Does not predict how long the completed work will hold; does not answer whether to celebrate or stay wary.

name: 未济
situation_en: One breath short — not yet done; the moment isn't ripe, the road is long, but the door isn't shut.
boundary_en: Does not predict when it can be done; does not answer whether to wait longer or take another road.
